pages.text: Your soul is a private dimension of your own - somewhere you can go, and always come back from.$(p)Nothing you build there is just for show. What you make of it changes what you can do out here.
There is no long setup. Craft a $(item)SoulKey$(0), step through it, and everything else grows from what you build inside.

If you still aren't sure where to start, this book (as well as advancements) should help you find what the next step is. The book is set up to unlock new entries with every advancement completed.$(p)For now though, here's a tip:
All you need is a little bit of iron and an ender pearl
pages.title: SoulKey
